brief:
# Flubs, Big Table

> **Seed:** Flubs built to be a fucking monster, so it can win at six- and seven-player tables.

Fill the front matter first: `mode`, `tier`, `source`, `assembly` (the three forks in `PROCESS.md`).
Then `python3 _tools/deck.py check <this folder>` tells you the next step.

## Thesis

**Flubs runs at high RPM: dig every turn, pay for it on earlier turns, and win by digging to the bottom.**
The fun is the win. Dug's engine ranking (2026-11-07): dig > time-shift > land loop = spell storm > token pingers.

**End state (priced, no commander damage):**
1. **Thassa's Oracle** (UU) with library at or below devotion to blue. Backup: **Jace, Wielder of Mysteries** (draw from an empty library wins). Flubs plus Abundance plus off-hand casts burn the library.
2. **Damage axis** when the dig is cut off: Valakut Exploration end-step damage, Delayed Blast Fireball (foretold: 5 to each opponent), Impending Flux, Guttersnipe; multiplied by Fated Firepower (+X) and Isengard Unleashed (x3). Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle with Dryad (every land is a Mountain) adds 3 per land.
3. Kill-turn cost: about 40 mana across the setup turns and the go-off turn, most of it pre-paid through foretell, suspend, plot and hideaway, or made by Tectonic Split / landfall. [INFERRED, not goldfished]

## Commander

Flubs, the Fool (real card, no reskin). Every land play and every cast fires one trigger: draw at hand 0, discard at hand 1+.
**Floor:** Flubs dies on sight -> the deck still ramps and casts from exile; recast is 3 + 2 per tax.
**Trace:** Lotus Bloom is suspended for 0 (no Flubs trigger, but the hand empties without a discard). Three upkeeps later it is cast free -> Flubs trigger at hand 0 -> draw.

## Engine map (see the 2026-11-07 session)

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Hand = 0] --> B[Play land or cast spell]
  B --> C{Flubs trigger}
  C -->|hand = 0| D[Draw - Abundance picks land or nonland]
  C -->|hand >= 1| E[Discard - madness casts it]
  D --> B
  E --> B
  X[Pre-paid: foretell, suspend, plot, hideaway] --> B
  D -->|library empty| W[Thassa's Oracle / Jace wins]
```

Stalls and their breakers:
- **S1, land stuck (no drop left):** Azusa, Dryad, Exploration (extra drops); Llanowar Scout, PuPu UFO, Growth Spiral (land in without a drop); Wild Mongrel, Ravenous Bloodseeker (free discard); any cast from exile with a land in hand discards it.
- **S2, spell stuck (no mana):** Abundance picks a land; pre-paid casts; Lotus Cobra, Tireless Provisioner, Omnath; Tectonic Split; Sage of the Beyond and Cosmos Charger.
- **S3, library empty:** Thassa's Oracle, Jace.

## Skeleton

| Slot | BUILD-SPEC standard | This deck's target | Why it differs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lands | ~37 | 36 | Flubs needs land plays, but 16 ramp plus fetch lines cover the gap |
| Ramp / fixing | 10-11 | 16 (+ Rousing Refrain, Strike It Rich, Tectonic Split in flex) | Dug's call: ramp hard, pre-pay the setup, build a castle. Starting the engine fast is paramount |
| Draw | 8-9 | 5 dig + Flubs | Flubs is the draw engine; Abundance, Valakut Exploration, Fblthp, Augur, Zuko, Ignite the Future dig without filling the hand |
| Interaction | 8-10 | 7 hidden (Null Brooch replaces Stratus Dancer, 2026-11-12) | Held off-hand (foretell, face-down, instant answers) because Flubs cannot hold cards. Enchantment answers: Green Slime and Boseiju only (bend accepted); no non-targeted answer (bend accepted) |
| Wipes | 0-2 | 0 | Delayed Blast Fireball wipes opposing small creatures |
| Protection | - | 3 (Willbender, Boltbender cut 2026-11-12) | Flubs is rarely the first target at this table |
| Stall breakers | - | 5 | See engine map |
| Flex | - | 19 | Tutors (3), graveyard turns (Past in Flames, Gaea's Will), cascade/storm, madness, hidden damage |

cardq quota on 2026-11-07: draw 7 LOW, removal 7 LOW, ench 0 LOW, nontarget 0 LOW. Bends above.

## Game plan

1. **Turns 1-3:** ramp (Strike It Rich, Lotus Bloom, dorks, Moxes). Land Flubs early. Empty the hand by suspending and foretelling, not by discarding.
2. **Turns 3-5:** build the castle. Hidden answers on the board (foretold, face-down). Abundance, Valakut Exploration, extra land drops.
3. **Go-off turn:** cast the pre-paid cards, chain with Abundance picks, Past in Flames or Gaea's Will for a second chain. Stop before the library is empty unless Oracle or Jace is ready.
4. **Thassa's Oracle trap:** a hellbent Flubs draw from an empty library loses before the Oracle resolves. Cast Oracle while cards remain.

## Maybe board

Moved off during the build: Surge of Brilliance; Alex Wilder; Swiftfoot Boots; Darksteel Plate; Sol Talisman; Fellwar Stone; Hermitic Herbalist; Laboratory Maniac; The Locust God; Dual Strike; Fiery Temper; Lotus Field; Hidden Volcano / Cataract / Nursery; Branch of Vitu-Ghazi.
Moved off 2026-11-12 (finished art and names kept in maybe.json): Stratus Dancer, Willbender, Boltbender, Rattleclaw Mystic, Grapeshot. Reason: the 3-mana morphs clog turns and eat mana that cheap chains need; Grapeshot does not scale at 7 players. Eruth came back in.
Full mechanic pool: claude.ai doc "Flubs Big Table: Mechanic Pool".

## Relationship to the cardboard Flubs

Sister deck to `decks/urg-temur/flubs-the-fool` (real cardboard, tier 2). Built from scratch, not from the purchased list. Cards proven on the cardboard deck may be carried over on their merits. The cardboard deck stays frozen on its 11-02 list until its 4 recorded games are done.

## Build log

Waves live in `CANDIDATES-wave<N>-<topic>.md` beside this file; table evidence goes in `BUILD-LOG.md`.

- 2026-11-07: list written, cardq clean, 100-card MPC print sheet built (12 sheets). See BUILD-LOG.md.
